name: Misaki Sumire
source: Youngest daughter of a family of great musicians. She is always compared to her parents and older sister and thus has high expectations. She feels a lot of pressure and anxiety because of this. She cares deeply for [url=/c5934]Elis[/url]. She is part of the choir and has a soprano voice.
translation: Youngest daughter of a family of great musicians. She is always compared to her parents and older sister and thus has high expectations.
